instructions.text: Use this template to organize a generic application packet. It does not replace the current instructions from the organization you will send the packet to.
Before adding files, obtain the current application instructions and compare their document types, page order, filenames, number of files, and size limits with this template.
Assign each document to the matching category, then review the assignment and order yourself. PaperWorkShell does not decide whether a document satisfies a requirement.
Before submission, review every included page for readability and check that no page or side you intend to send is missing.
PaperWorkShell creates files on this device. It does not submit them.

requirements.title: Application form
requirements.guidance: Add the current application form intended for this packet. Review every page you intend to send. PaperWorkShell does not decide whether the form is complete or correct.

requirements.title: Identity evidence
requirements.guidance: Add the identity document or documents requested by the current application instructions. If an identity document has a front and back, check whether the current instructions ask for both sides. Include each side they ask for, and review that each side is readable.

requirements.title: Proof of address
requirements.guidance: Add the proof of address requested by the current application instructions. Review that every intended page is present and readable.

requirements.title: Supporting evidence
requirements.guidance: Add the supporting documents requested by the current application instructions. Review their assignment and order yourself.

warnings.message: The numeric limits and filenames in this generic template are an example packaging profile. Compare them with the current application instructions before export.
Review whether each side of the identity evidence requested by the current instructions is present and readable.
Review every included page for readability, correct orientation, and missing content.
PaperWorkShell checks only the packaging rules configured in this template. It does not decide eligibility, provide legal advice, verify identity, submit documents, or guarantee acceptance.
